errorCodes.meaning: No key record on this custodian carries the named `keyId`. See [category conventions](../../_shared/0.1/CONVENTIONS.md#1-family-error-codes).
A key record already carries the target identifier; the custodian refuses rather than overwrite it. See [category conventions](../../_shared/0.1/CONVENTIONS.md#1-family-error-codes).

schema.description: Change a key's identifier. The key material is untouched — only the name it is addressed by changes.

keyId.description: The identifier the key is addressed by today.

newKeyId.description: The identifier it should be addressed by afterwards. MUST NOT collide with an existing record.
